Home » News » Lassen Welcomes the Chancellor’s Office
Last week we had the honor of welcoming Chancellor Christian, representatives from the Chancellor’s Office, the Board of Governors, and the Student Senate for California Community Colleges.
Our guests toured Lassen College, visited our Career Technical Education pathways, and connected with Student Ambassadors to learn more about the Cougar experience.

ASSIST (Articulation System Stimulating Interinstitutional Student Transfer) is the official repository of articulation for California’s University of California (UC), California State Universities (CSU), and private/independent colleges or universities. It displays reports of how course credits earned at a community college can be applied when transferred to another campus in California. You can also explore majors at the UC, CSU, and independent colleges/universities by using their Transfer Major Explorer. This website is best used in conjunction with a Lassen College Counselor.
